claims.text: The song was released as the lead single from PSY’s sixth studio album, Psy 6 (Six Rules), Part 1.
The phrase “Gangnam Style” refers to the nouveau riche lifestyles associated with Seoul’s Gangnam district.
MusicBrainz lists several recordings remixed from this track, including PSY’s “Gangnam Style (Afrojack remix)” and the Diplo remix featuring 2 Chainz and Tyga.
claims.verdictReason: The two MusicBrainz relationship excerpts identify two remixes, but do not establish several.
